richiami.difetto: For affected machines there is a potential defect concerning some welds on the frame which may have insufficient strength. Riding on uneven road surfaces or through potholes may result in cracks forming causing the welded area to break without warning and the lower cradle to separate from the steering head and the frame to collapse.
richiami.rimedio: ​​All affected machines will be fitted with a new updated replacement frame.​
